entries.about: Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. entries.about: A burst from a point: dots or stars that fly out, slow and fall; confetti that is thrown up, flutters and falls; sparks thrown one way; and a ring that spreads from the same point. All seeded: the same on every render.

entries.name: pen-draw
entries.about: A line is drawn on as a pen would draw it: the stroke grows from its start with a dot riding its tip. An underline, a circle round a word, an arrow or a tick.

entries.name: shape-morph
entries.about: One shape turns into the next: a circle, a star, a rounded square, a drop and a heart, each held for a moment. Every point of the outline travels; the shape breathes with a slow turn while it holds.

entries.name: slam-title
entries.about: A title slams in from large on an accelerating ease, the frame flashes white on the landing frame, the ground shakes and a ring spreads; then the title stays dead still while streaks keep running behind it.

entries.name: speed-lines
entries.about: Streaks rush past in one direction while a card whips across and lands blurred, then sharpens: what a fast move looks like at its fastest frames.

entries.name: spring-pop
entries.about: A badge pops in on a spring (named by its damping ratio) over rays that keep turning behind it; a star of sparks marks the landing. The badge lands and stays still: the rays are what keeps moving.

entries.name: streak-wipe
entries.about: A directional streak wipe: the next picture comes in along one direction as bands of unequal reach, softened while they move.

entries.name: type-on
entries.about: Text that is typed character by character with a cursor, or that settles out of changing characters from left to right. The typing has a cue every third character; the decode one glitch.
